image_description: Two individuals standing outdoors in an academic setting. The person on the left wears a light gold/champagne colored academic gown and a mortarboard cap with a tassel. The person on the right wears a black academic gown with colorful velvet bars on the sleeves (indicating doctoral status) over a white shirt and tie, holding a rolled diploma. Both gowns feature wide, open sleeves.

Both gowns exhibit clear bilateral symmetry and a vertical center-front opening consistent with academic regalia.
The fabric drapes loosely, hiding the specific shape of the torsos and arms, consistent with the voluminous nature of the garment.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The distinctive bell-shaped sleeves are clearly visible on both subjects, hanging loosely around the wrists/hands.
The front edges of the gowns are visible, showing the standard panel construction.
The subject on the right clearly wears a collared shirt and tie underneath. The subject on the left appears to wear a dress or blouse.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The black gown shows a matte finish typical of polyester blends. The gold gown has a slight sheen but fits the general material profile.
No harsh specular highlights are present; the light diffusion suggests a smooth, semi-matte textile.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sleeve openings extend significantly past the wrists, creating the characteristic 'bell' shape.
